1. The item is procured against requirement of project 752 MRSAM (IN + IAF). 2. The item should be supplied as per i) TSQD Doc No: DRDL/6200/78/PR/050/R&QA Issue No.02, Rev No.0, Dt: 12.09.2016 and Amend ment TSQD/P2 Igniter/AMD/01 dt: 08.03.2017. ii) Drawings as per BOM given in TSQD. iii) Vetted Scope of work (SoW) documents issued by Project LRSAM. iv) QAP Doc No. MSQAA/HYD/MRSAM/P2 IGNITOR ASSEMBLY/01, issue No.01, Rev 00, dt: May 2025 . 3. The list of deliverables to be supplied with each P2 Igniter Assembly. i) P2 Igniter Housing, Drg. No. 5421102000001, Qty - 1 No. ii) P2 Igniter Closure, Drg. No. 5421102000002, Qty - 1 No. iii)Primer Charge Housing, Drg. No. 5421102000003, Qty - 1 No. iv) P2 Pellet Housing, Drg. No. 5421102000004, Qty - 1 No. v) P2 Igniter Arrestor – 1, Drg. No. 5420802000016, Qty - 1 No. vi) P2 Igniter Arrestor – 2, Drg. No. 5420802000017, Qty - 1 No. vii)Philip Head CSK 90 Deg Screw ISO 7046 M3 X 6- 10.9 Class Qty-2Nos. viii)Slotted Head CSK 90 Deg Screw IS 2009 M4 X 0.7 X 7 -10.9 Class-Qty 36 Nos. 4. Where ever DRDL is there, Read as DRDL/Project/BDL in TSQD/SOW documents. 5. Ordered Quantities are qualified (Useable) deliverable Units. 6. Inspection Authority/Agency: The Principal Director, MSQAA, Hyderabad or his authorized repres entative or Nominated Inspection Agency. 7. BDL/MSQAA reserves the right to audit the vendor premises and the premises of their subcontr actors. 8. Inspection reports, Test reports, Test specimens and MSQAA Inspection clearance certificate (I- Note/CoC) to be submitted with supplies. 9. P2 Igniter pellets, 1 gm Primer Charge as mentioned in the P2 Igniter Assy (Drg No. 5421102000 000) are not included in this Scope of procurement.

10. Raw materials and sub-assemblies required for manufacturing of item is in Vendor scope. No F IM will be issued by the BDL. All the raw materials shall be inspected and cleared by MSQAA prior t o commencement of P2 Igniter production activities. 11. Fasteners required shall be procured from approved source M/s Aero Fasteners Pvt Ltd, New D elhi as per latest TSQD & SoW documents of Fasteners. 12. All Jigs, Fixtures, Gauges, Tools & Test Equipment, Support Equipment, Test Setups etc., which are required for Fabrication, Assembly, Testing and Inspection of P2 Igniter as per the Technical do cument is in Vendor’s Scope and to be approved by Project/MSQAA/BDL. 13. Vendor should ensure Periodical Approval/Calibration of all above Tools/Equipment involved in production of P2 Igniter Assembly. 14. Complete inspection, reports and documentation shall be carried out by the Vendor as mentio ned in Technical Documents. 15. All the latest revisions, versions, amendments, updations and changes of applicable. Observati ons (if any) w.r.t higher revisions or updations shall be intimated to BDL. 16. The firm shall prepare detailed process plan, Inspection plan and QA matrix indicating all stage s of Assembly/inspection from the raw material stage till the final product is realized and approval shall be obtained from MSQAA/DRDL/BDL for all the documents before commencing production. 17. In case of vendor subcontracts a part of operation for the order in part or full, the same has to be informed to MSQAA/BDL and vendor shall submit relevant documents to MSQAA 18. Quantity required delivery Schedules are as per BDL Purchase Order. All the other technical de tails mentioned in the SoW and TSQD are applicable. 19. All documents of LRSAM are applicable for MRSAM including latest versions, amendments and changes. 20. Place of Inspection: At Vendor place or any of their units or Work centre or their Sub-Contracto r location. 2. Commercial Terms:

1. Delivery Schedule: Delivery shall commence from T0 + 12 months @100 Nos per month (minimum) -Where T0 is issue of MSQAA vetted PO to the vendor. Early deliveries are also accepted. 2. Taxes & Duties: Excise duty exemption certificate will not be provided. Customs duty exemptio n certificate will not be provided for the imported items. Taxes will be as applicable at the time of s upply. In case of delay beyond delivery schedules of PO then any increase in levies at the time of s upply will not be considered and only earlier percent of levy will be paid. 3. Payment terms: 90% payment with 100% taxes and duties will be made within 30 days after re ceipt and acceptance of material at BDL on pro rata basis. Balance 10% payment against submissi on of PBG with validity till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. 4. Security Deposit (SD): security deposit shall be submitted by the successful bidders for 5% of th e order value (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from scheduled banks) within one week from the date of purchase order and valid up to successful exec ution of the order till the last delivery date as per purchase order plus 3 months claim period. 5. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG): Supplier shall furnish a PBG for 5% of order value (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from scheduled banks) vali d till end of warranty period plus 3 months claim period. 6. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver th e goods / services, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from th e supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (including duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to delive r as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof, subject to maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if delay is attri butable to vendor. 7. Warranty: The stores supplied must bear warranty for 30 months from the date of acceptance a t BDL, warranty certificate should accompany with supplies. 8. All the documents and drawings supplied are the property of DRDO/BDL. These documents and drawings shall not be used for any other purpose. The vendor is strictly prohibited from further util izing or passing of any of the design details or the details of the drawings whole or part. 9. Non-Disclosure Agreement: Vendor has to submit Non-Disclosure Agreement as per the format provided by BDL

10. Option Clause: - BDL retains the right to place order for additional quantity up to a maximum o f 100%of the originally PO/contract quantity at the same rate & terms of PO/contract during execu tion or within one year from the date of last supply of the PO/contract. 11. Packing: The items shall be securely packed in cardboard/wooden box, wrapped in bubble she et with rubber pads and thermo-coal cushioning to avoid contact with packing casing. If any specif ic packing instructions given in the TSQD shall be followed. The packed items shall be withstand se vere road transport conditions, safe handling and storage. Packing list to be pasted on the box. 12. Product support: Post warranty service is to be provided for the items supplied up to 20 years on mutually agreed terms and conditions basis. 3. Other terms & conditions: 1. Vendor has to comply for supplier quality requirements (SQR). 2. No Custom Duty Exemption Certificate, No Excise Duty Exemption Certificate and No FIM will b e issued by BDL. 3. Fall Clause: The Price charged for items supplied under the purchase order/contract shall be in N o event exceed the lowest price at which the vendor sells the stores or offers to sell the items of Id entical description to any persons/organizations including the purchase of any department of the c entral Govt. or any dept. of the state govt. or any statutory undertaking of the central or state govt . As the case may be during the period till the performance of the supply order placed and during currency of the purchase order/contract is completed. If at any time during the said period, the co ntractor reduces the sales price, sells or offers to sell such items to any person/organization includ ing the purchaser or any department of central govt. or any dept. of state govt. or any statutory undertaking of the central or state govt. as the case may be at a price lower than the price charge able under the contract, He shall forthwith notify such reduction/sale or offer to sale to the BDL an d the price payable under the contract for the items supplied after the date of coming into force of such reduction or sale or offer to sale shall stand correspondingly reduced. 4. Risk purchase clause: In the event the supplier fails to fulfill the purchase order obligations, BDL reserves the right: i) To purchase elsewhere without notice to the supplier, on account and at the risk of the supplier, the stores not delivered or other of similar description (which in the opinion of BDL shall be readily procurable) without cancelling the purchase order in respect of consignment not yet due for delive ry.(or) ii) To cancel the purchase order in the event action being taken as above the supplier shall be liabl e for any loss which BDL may sustain on that account by the supplier shall not be entitled to any g ain on repurchase made against default.

5. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offer s by conducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors t o equal level playing field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender wi thout e-reverse auction , if required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the di scretion of BDL. The details of auctioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarizatio n will be arranged for the same, if required. 7. Vendor to upload Raksha Udyami Number (NCAGE+) Certificate. 8. BDL reserves right to split the Purchase order into two or more as per our requirement. 8. All the general terms and conditions are as per BDL limited tender terms and conditions. 9. Consignee address: Incharge(Store) - LR/MRSAM Bharat Dynamics Limited, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad - 500098, Telangana. Phone No: 040-2458 7770. IMM No: 040-2458 7572. Note: - The Material to be supplied along with e-way bill, duplicate copy for transporter (GST Invoic e), Packing list and I-note/Inspection clearance/COC/Warranty (whichever is applicable). . 6.
